node.title: Using system command not able to run though the script
node.author: chopraa
node.doctext:
Hello Team ,

I am using system command in my script which is running on windows using CMD . The command which I am running is mentioned below .

system("simple_pin_$thost.pl $thost | findstr \n "2016 TTL timed" >> ping_$thost.txt" );

when run though the script it gives below error message .

Number found where operator expected at C:\Windows\Scripts\Run_ping.pl line 16, near ""simple_pin_$thost.pl $thost | findstr \n "2016" (Missing operator before 2016?) Bareword found where operator expected at C:\Windows\Scripts\Run_ping.pl line 16, near "2016 TTL" (Missing operator before TTL?) syntax error at C:\Windows\Scripts\Run_ping.pl line 16, near ""simple_pin_$thost.pl $thost | findstr \n "2016" Execution of C:\Windows\Scripts\Run_ping.pl aborted due to compilation errors.

-Ajay
